facts.fact: Zambia's draft street naming and addressing policy, covering postcode and digital addressing and a national address database, awaits final approval, and ZICTA's ongoing National Addressing and Postcode Project has addressed about 15 Lusaka neighbourhoods, according to the UNGEGN paper submitted by Zambia.

ZMB.note: The document states nothing on public digital skills.
The document states nothing on local government office connections.
The document names stakeholder committees on place-name policy, not a consultation on a digital law with outside participants; nothing stated that answers the study.
The document states nothing on school internet or curriculum.
